{{Quote|May you have sunlight, abundant water, and deep roots.|A Daltarri representative, to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] during his diplomatic visit on Daltarri|<ref name="The Clone Wars: The Starcrusher Trap">''[[The Clone Wars: The Starcrusher Trap]]''</ref>}}
The '''Daltarri''' were a [[Plant/Legends|plant]]-based [[Species/Legends|species]] that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Daltarri]].

==Biology==
Their bodies were [[Color/Legends|green]], with some orange-red "[[Hair/Legends|hair]]"-like extension on at least one individual visible. Their eyes were multi-faceted, like some insect's and they spoke through long, snout-like extensions from their faces. The Daltarri moved around on several tentacles and had two upper tentacles serving as arms.

==History==
They were allied with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], though appeared to not actively participate in the fight against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was sent on a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] visit to their world, to deliver seeds to their leaders in a gesture of goodwill. Daltarri believed strongly in the concept of allies who would aid them without questioning, a philosophy they explained to Skywalker during his visit.
